newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-St George cuts home loan rate 0.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-St George cuts home loan rate 0.5 pct.

text.p: St George Bank Ltd said on Wednesday it would cut its standard variable home loan rate by half a percentage point to 8.25 percent, effective from January 1.
The regional bank said it would also cut its no-frills "Great Australian home loan" rate to 7.45 percent from 7.95 percent from December 18.
These loans make up about 20 percent of St George's home loan portfolio.
St George said the cuts followed the Reserve Bank of Australia's announcement earlier that it would cut official cash interest rates by half a percentage point to 6.0 percent.
The 'reward rate' for long term or loyalty home loan customers would fall to 7.90 percent from 8.40 percent.

"St George was responding to the needs of its customers and had already begun the process of restructuring its funding and redeveloping systems to allow immediate responses to further changes in monetary policy," St George's Retail Bank Head Neil Berkett said in a statement.
"We accept that in the future the customer expects all banks to pass on cuts immediately," Berkett said.
